name: Raf-1 proto-oncogene, serine/threonine kinase
pathways: regulation of Rho protein signal transduction

function.text: RAF1 encodes RAF proto-oncogene serine/threonine-protein kinase. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and protein serine kinase activity. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of Rho protein signal transduction.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include Noonan syndrome (autosomal dominant); Noonan syndrome 5 (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Amphicrine-like carcinoma; Pleomorphic xanthoastrocytoma; Pancreatic acinar cell carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
